title: Causal subspace rescue of semantic installation under the A1 demonstration->query attention knockout
frozen_before: any arm of this experiment has been generated or read
scientific_question: Under the live A1 attention knockout, does restoring ONLY the component of the query-side residual state that lies in a TRAIN-learned installation-predictive subspace restore semantic installation -- or does the existing whole-state rescue work through something other than that component?
hypothesis: The installation-predictive component of the query-side representation is a causal mediator of the knockout's effect on semantic installation. If so, a projection-restricted rescue along that component recovers installation materially, while same-norm orthogonal, shuffled-label and random subspaces at the same layer, positions and injected norm do not.
null_hypothesis: The installation-predictive component is a correlate. A projection-restricted rescue along it recovers no more installation than a same-norm control subspace does.

population.cells: C (the installed-mapping cell); A/B/E enter only the candidate fit's completeness rule
population.domain_scope: ts116m frozen split minus EXCLUDED_DOMAINS (restaurant_kitchen, school_campus, subway_station)
population.never_pooled: button and basket are separate transfer conditions and are reported separately; a floor-limited result on one is CANNOT ANSWER, not a negative replication

intervention.placebo_band: 20-28 (the dose-matched late-band control arm, named `ctrl` in DR-071/CONT-054)
intervention.rescue_layer: SELECTED ON TRAIN by scripts/dcs_csi_axis.py; recorded as meta.selected_layer in the candidate artifact; identical for every rescued arm including the full-state positive control
intervention.rescue_positions: query (the entire query span) -- identical positions in every rescued arm, so the full-state arm and the subspace arms differ ONLY in the projection
intervention.formula: h' = h + P_W (h_donor - h), P_W = W^T W with W orthonormal
intervention.donor: clean (an unhooked forward over the same templated string); token identity over the patched span re-verified before every write

candidate_construction.fit_population: TRAIN split only, minus excluded domains; the script REFUSES if any validation or test domain reaches the fit or if the corpus contains test rows
candidate_construction.site: rel-6, FROZEN to the prior query-probe winner and NOT re-searched, so this experiment adds no new site-selection multiplicity

families.semantic: fit on the semantic_one_word forward -- the SAME forward the intervention acts on. This is the representation the causal claim is about, but it shares a forward pass with the readout, so it is NOT offered as a clean observational claim.
families.behavioral: fit on the behavioural forward -- the non-circular lineage the existing Q1 probe used; asks whether that axis TRANSFERS to the semantic forward.

candidate_construction.family_adjudication: VALIDATION chooses between the two frozen families. TEST is not involved.

arms.name: KO_SELF
arms.desc: knockout + whole-state rescue with donor=self; intervention-mechanics identity control; MUST be inert

arms.name: KO_FULL
arms.desc: knockout + whole-state clean rescue; POSITIVE CONTROL and upper bound

arms.name: KO_PLS
arms.desc: knockout + rank-r* PLS subspace (cand_pls{r*}), r* selected on TRAIN

arms.name: KO_ORTH
arms.desc: knockout + ctrl_orth, norm-matched to cand_rank1; THE PRIMARY COMPARATOR

endpoints.primary: y_install -- concept-free semantic installation = softmax(logp_concept, logp_codeword) on the semantic_one_word channel, cell C, as defined by dcs_cont_layerpos_map.load_installation
endpoints.why_not_refusal: the refusal endpoint yields 5-12 informative domains at 90 domains (S-002) and has 0.39 power for a recovery-sized effect (S-004); the semantic endpoint moves 67/67 domains under the same knockout (CONT-054). Refusal cannot separate arms that are closer together than full-rescue-vs-KO.
secondary: recovery fraction of the KO-induced installation loss, with a degeneracy guard
realised intervention dose: written delta norm, captured energy fraction, norm-match degeneracy count
semantic option mass (the readout validity gate, min 0.05)
endpoints.forbidden_as_primary: semantic_forced_choice -- the probe names the concept and has leaked severely before

statistics.estimator: within-domain mean of y_install, then the paired across-domain mean difference between arms
statistics.test: exact two-sided sign-flip randomisation test over domains where the number of informative domains permits enumeration, Monte-Carlo otherwise
statistics.must_report_alongside_every_p: the attainable p-floor 2/2**k for k informative domains
statistics.train_validation: TRAIN and VALIDATION reported separately and never pooled; VALIDATION is the replication

primary_contrast: mean over domains of [ y_install(KO_AXIS) - y_install(KO_ORTH) ], both norm-matched, same layer, same positions, same donor

success_criterion.manipulation_check: mean_d[y(KO) - y(BASE)] is negative and of the established magnitude (about -0.2); otherwise VOID
success_criterion.instrument_capability: KO_FULL - KO > 0 with a domain-clustered CI excluding 0; if the whole-state rescue itself does not recover installation, the subspace question is CANNOT ANSWER for want of a capable instrument, NOT a negative
success_criterion.primary: KO_AXIS - KO_ORTH > 0 with a domain-clustered CI excluding 0 AND an exact sign-flip p < 0.05 that is strictly above its own attainable floor
success_criterion.specificity: the candidate's recovery exceeds every shuffled and random control's recovery, each pairwise test surviving Holm correction
success_criterion.replication: the sign and rough magnitude reproduce on VALIDATION at the frozen layer, rank, site and positions, without retuning
success_criterion.dose: the candidate arm's written delta norm is matched to the controls' within 1e-6 per position, and the norm-match degeneracy counter is 0 on the controls used for the primary contrast

failure_criterion: KO_AXIS - KO_ORTH is not distinguishable from 0 while KO_FULL - KO is clearly positive and KO_SELF is inert. That is an informative negative: the site carries the effect but the installation-predictive component is not the causal variable, and the whole-state rescue works through something else.
cannot_answer_criteria: KO_FULL - KO is not distinguishable from 0 (no capable instrument at this layer/positions)
the KO manipulation check fails on this bank
the readout option-mass gate fails, making y_install undefined on a material fraction of rows
the recovery-fraction denominator (KO_FULL - KO) is degenerate; the fraction is then withheld and only absolute recoveries are reported
for a codeword: installation is at floor or ceiling so no arm can move
void_conditions: any TEST domain appears in any arm's population
the knockout is not live on every row, or produces nonzero decode-time edits
the rescue does not fire on every row, or writes a zero-norm delta on the candidate arm
arms differ in prompt_sha16 on any shared prompt_id
attention implementation is not eager, or dtype is not bfloat16
the basis was fit on a population including validation or test domains
--rescue-basis-key does not resolve to the arm's declared basis in the row artifact
must_not_be_said_if_positive: The installed-meaning representation causes the jailbreak. (this experiment's endpoint is semantic installation, NOT behaviour; the behavioural link is Phase 5 and is separately powered)
F5 / A11 is the mechanism. (its demo-side site is bit-identical across ko and ctrl and cannot mediate A1)
We identified the circuit. (a representation is not a circuit; that is Phase 3)
This is the first causal intervention on demonstration->query attention in in-context learning. (FALSE -- see the literature report and the standing prohibition)
The representation is one-dimensional. (only if rank selection actually favours r=1 on VALIDATION, and stated as such)
must_not_be_said_if_null: The query-side representation carries no installation information. (a transplant that never demonstrated transfer capability cannot support that)
Semantic installation is not causally mediated. (a null on one subspace at one layer and one site is not a null on mediation)
The knockout does nothing. (it moves installation in 67/67 domains)
Basket failed to replicate. (say: could not test, if its endpoint is floor-limited)
reuse: No new experimental stack. score_behavior.py --rescue-* is the existing rescue path; the only additions are SubspaceDonorPatch and the three --rescue-basis* flags. The knockout, the readout, the option-mass gate, the liveness contract, the exclusion mechanism and the installation definition are all unchanged.
hardware_policy: every arm of a comparison runs in ONE SLURM allocation on ONE node, which also amortises the model load; hostname, GPU model, dtype, attention implementation and model revision are persisted per run
